name: ProfilesPreventLoginWithFailure
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

Prevent user login when a failure occurs while attaching an FSLogix container

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\PreventLoginWithFailure
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: ProfilesOutlookCachedMode
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

When the Profile Container is successfully attached, set Outlook to work in cached mode for the user. The setting change will only be effective for the specific user and for the length of the user session

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\OutlookCachedMode
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled (only if container is attached)

name: ProfilesProfileType
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Controls whether the VHD(x) file should be accessed directly, if a difference disk should be used, and if Read/Write or Read Only access should be used. The default value is Normal Profile.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\ProfileType
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Normal direct-access profile, 1= Read-write profile, 2 = Read-only profile, 3 = Try for read-write profile and fallback to read-only

name: ProfilesSizeInMBs
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specify the size for auto-created VHD(x) files.

NOTE:  Default is 30,000 (30GB) which is the same as "Not Configured"

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\SizeInMBs
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Min = 500, Max = 1000000

name: ProfilesVolumeWaitTimemilliseconds
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies the number of milliseconds to wait for the volume to be attached by the system. Default is 20,000 (20 seconds)

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\VolumeWaitTimeMS
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Min = 1000, Max = 1000000

name: ProfilesIsDynamicVHD
description:
[ENABLED BY DEFAULT]

NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

VHD(x)s will be dynamically allocated. VHD(x) file size will grow as data is added to the VHD(x). If disabled, VHD(x)s that are auto-created will be fully allocated.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\IsDynamic
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: ProfilesVHDXSectorSize
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

This setting is only applicable if the virtual disk type is VHDX

NOTE:  The default is the sytem default which is the same as "Not Configured"

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\VHDXSectorSize
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = System Default, 512, 4096

name: ProfilesKeepLocalDirectoryafterlogoff
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

The 'local_%username%' folder will be left on the system after logoff and will also be used again if the same user logs on again

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\KeepLocalDir
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

options.displayName: Shutdown on any FSLogix Profile logoff

name: ProfilesAccessNetworkasComputer
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

Attach as computer - folder must have permissions for computer objects

CAUTION:  Do not use this configuration setting unless your storage provider or architecture will NOT work with user-level permissions to the VHD(x) container locations. This setting will allow the virtual machine to access all the VHD(x) files on the storage provider creating a potential security risk.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\AccessNetworkAsComputerObject
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: ProfilesProfileDirectorySDDL
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

SDDL string representing the ACLs to use when creating the profile directory.

Registry Entry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\ProfileDirSDDL
Type: REG_SZ

name: ProfilesAttachedVHDSDDL
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

SDDL string representing the ACLs to use when attaching the VHD.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\AttachVHDSDDL
Type:  REG_SZ

name: ProfilesDeleteLocalProfileWhenVHDShouldApply
displayName: Delete Local Profile When VHD Should Apply
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

When the FSLogix Profiles system determines that a user should have a FSLogix profile but a local profile exists, the local profile WILL BE REMOVED and the user logged on with the FSLogix profile

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\DeleteLocalProfileWhenVHDShouldApply
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

options.displayName: Redirect TEMP and TMP to local drive
Redirect TEMP, TMP and INetCache to local drive

name: ProfilesRedirectType
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Configures legacy or FSLogix advanced redirection. The default is '2' which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\RedirectType
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Legacy = 1, FSLogix Redirection = 2

name: ProfilesRoamIdentity
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

Allows legacy roaming for credentials and tokens created by the Web Account Manager (WAM) system. Some Microsoft 365 applications may require authentication at every sign-in when disabled.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\RoamIdentity
Type: DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: ProfilesLockedRetryCount
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies the number of retries to perform when a VHD(x) file is locked (open by another process or computer). The default value is 12 retries which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\LockedRetryCount
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Min = 0, Max = 600

name: ProfilesEnabled
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

Controls whether or not the Profiles feature is active

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\Enabled
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

options.displayName: Read / Write profile - fallback to Read Only

name: ProfilesShutdownOnUserLogoff
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Shuts down the machine when a user logs off

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\ShutdownOnUserLogoff
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Any user, 2 = Any FSLogix Profile user

name: ProfilesCleanOutNotifications
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

This setting cleans out stale entries created by the Windows Push Notification Platform (WPN) and Windows Notification Facility (WFN) which under some conditions leads to slow sign-ins. Only enable this setting if directed by a Microsoft Support Engineer.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\CleanOutNotifications
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: ProfilesReattachCount
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

When a VHD(x) volume is detached unexpectedly, the FSLogix system will attempt to re-attach the volume. This value specifies how many times to retry. The default value is 60 retries which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\ReAttachRetryCount
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Min = 0, Max = 600

name: ProfilesRebootOnUserLogoff
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Reboots the machine when a user logs off

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\RebootOnUserLogoff
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Any user, 2 = Any FSLogix Profile user

name: ProfilesRedirectionXMLSourceFolder
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies the path to a folder containing the XML file. If the folder contains a redirections.xml, it will be copied to the local profile and immediately used.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\RedirXMLSourceFolder
Type:  REG_SZ

name: ProfilesReattachInterval
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

When a VHD(x) volume is detached unexpectedly, the FSLogix system will attempt to reattach the volume. This value specifies the number of seconds to wait between retries. The default value is 10 seconds which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\ReAttachIntervalSeconds
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Min = 1, Max = 60

name: ProfilesSetTempFolderstoLocalPath
displayName: Set Temp Folders to Local Path
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Redirects the TEMP, TMP, and INetCache paths to the local drive

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\SetTempToLocalPath
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = No Action, 1 = Redirect TEMP and TMP to Local Disk, 2 = Redirect INetCache to Local Disk, 3 = Redirect TEMP, TMP, INetCache to Local Disk

name: ProfilesVHDLocations
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies the network location where the VHD(X) files are stored.

Examples:
- Sinlge location:  \\<server fqdn>\<share name>
- Multiple locations: \\<server 1 fqdn>\<share name>;\\<server 2 fqdn>\<share name>

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\VHDLocations
REG_SZ

name: ProfilesSIDDirectorySDDL
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

SDDL string representing the ACLs to use when creating the SID container folder.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\SIDDirSDDL
Type:  REG_SZ

name: ProfilesRoamSearch
description:
NOTE:
-  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.
-  Do not use this setting with Windows Server 2019 (or later) or Windows 10 (or later). Newer operating systems support per-user search.

Enable search roaming in legacy Windows Operating Systems

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\RoamSearch
Type:  DWORD
Values: 0 = Disabled, 1 = Single User Search, 2 = Multi-user Search

name: ProfilesRemoveOrphanedOSTFilesOnLogoff
displayName: Remove Orphaned OST Files On Logoff
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

Removes duplicate OST files

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\RemoveOrphanedOSTFilesOnLogoff
Type: DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

name: ProfilesLockedRetryInterval
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies the number of seconds to wait between retries. The default value is 5 seconds which is the same as "Not Configured".

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\LockedRetryInterval
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Min = 0, Max = 600

name: ProfilesPreventLoginWithTempProfile
description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

Prevent user login when a user receives a temporary Windows profile

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\PreventLoginWithTempProfile
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled

options.displayName: Reboot only on any FSLogix Profile logoff

name: ProfilesInstallAppxPackages
description:
[ENABLED BY DEFAULT]

NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled or Disabled, setting it back to Not Configured has NO EFFECT.

When enabled, this setting will read the AppxPackages.xml manifest file from the user's profile and install / re-register the list of applications.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\InstallAppxPackages
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled
